title: Which stream supplies the next card?
hook: Several sorted streams compete through their visible heads.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Merge several sorted streams with one live candidate from each stream in a min-priority queue.

misconception: Merging many streams requires rescanning every remaining item.
objective: Merge several sorted streams with one live candidate from each stream in a min-priority queue.

claims.text: Only the head of each stream competes in the priority queue. Removing the winner reveals one replacement from that same stream, preserving access to the smallest remaining value without sorting the full remainder.
